events.event: Immigration DG Hendarsam Marantoko confirms ATR/BPN Minister Nusron Wahid travelled to Singapore via Batam and Malaysia after skipping two KPK summons in an ATR/BPN corruption investigation, and says no travel ban (cekal) has been requested.
events.key_numbers: Missed KPK examinations on 7 Oct and 15 Oct 2026 · max 2 summons before a bring-in order under new KUHAP · Immigration could not say whether he is back · no cekal request received
events.why_it_matters: A sitting minister is being summoned by KPK and has not appeared; the next step (forced bring-in or travel ban) tests how the new KUHAP works on powerful officials.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered same day by CNN Indonesia, Kompas, Liputan6, Media Indonesia, IDN Times, Beritasatu

events.event: Students protest on the Prabowo-Gibran government's second anniversary: BEM UI at Tugu Tani in Jakarta, thousands at DPRD DIY in Yogyakarta, and protests planned at 33 points in Makassar, with demands centred on karhutla/flood disaster status, MBG/KDMP review and military role.
events.key_numbers: Jakarta 9,505 security personnel (7,660 Polri, 1,540 TNI) · Tugu Tani 15:00 WIB · Makassar 33 points, ~3,000 personnel · Yogyakarta 'ribuan' (thousands) · 5 demands listed by Kompas
events.why_it_matters: Shows what students are asking of the government after two years, from haze and MBG to the military's civilian role.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional feed (several items) and Kompas; photo reports from Bundaran HI

events.event: Preacher Khalid Basalamah testifies at the Tipikor court in the 2023-2024 additional hajj quota corruption trial that his staff returned US$354,500 to KPK; former Religious Affairs Minister Yaqut Cholil Qoumas is among four defendants.
events.key_numbers: US$354,500 returned (3,545 x US$100 notes) · KPK also seized US$200,000 · BPK-based state loss Rp622,090,207,166 · 4 defendants · 313 special hajj organizers (PIHK) allegedly benefited
events.why_it_matters: The hajj quota case touches the queue of pilgrims waiting years for departure; witness testimony shows where the money allegedly went.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNN Indonesia items on the page (photo report + report)

events.event: Prabowo meets Chief of Staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo at Istana Merdeka and instructs him to oversee strategic priority programmes so they hit their targets, a day before the second-anniversary events.
events.key_numbers: Listyo appointed KSP 1 Oct 2026 · meeting Mon 19 Oct 2026 · programmes cited: KDKMP, hospital construction incl. type C regional hospitals · met 13 labour union representatives in October
events.why_it_matters: Shows the former police chief now steering delivery of flagship programmes like MBG-era cooperatives and hospitals.

events.event: A Majelis Kehormatan Hakim (MA and Komisi Yudisial) permanently dismisses, with pension rights, Cibinong District Court judge INS for 129 working days of unexcused absence and prior disciplinary record.
events.key_numbers: 129 working days absent · 3 earlier sanctions (2016, 2022, 2023) · 2-year non-hammer sanction from Aug 2023 not complied with · hearing 19 Oct 2026 · panel 3 MA + 4 KY members
events.why_it_matters: Rare public look at how judges are disciplined, alongside a second judge sanctioned for immoral conduct the same day.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional feed (two judge-sanction items)

events.event: Bareskrim names five suspects in the blackout case that hit Batam-Bintan island.
events.key_numbers: 5 suspects · details of cause, roles and outage scale not read (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: A power outage on two islands leading to criminal suspects is unusual for ordinary residents who rely on the grid.

events.event: Pomdam TT detains a TNI member as a suspect in a 46.93 kg crystal-meth (sabu) case in Riau.
events.key_numbers: 46.93 kg sabu · 1 TNI suspect (from headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Adds to current debate on military discipline and civilian trial after the MK Military Courts ruling.
